title: WINDI-HIOS Proof Schema
description: Proof layer schema for receipt generation and verification

execution_id.description: Reference to execution that generated this proof

receipt_type.description: Classification per Guardian refinement. MUST match mutation_class: CRITICAL→constitutional, STANDARD→operational, EPHEMERAL→ephemeral

parent_receipt.description: Parent receipt ID for chain integrity. MUST be null for EPHEMERAL receipts during DRAFT-SKELETON phase per Bootstrap Protocol §4

mutation_receipt_binding.description: Bidirectional enforcement: CRITICAL⇒constitutional, STANDARD⇒operational, EPHEMERAL⇒ephemeral. Schema permits all combinations but validation layer MUST reject mismatches.

ephemeral_parent_restriction.description: If receipt_type=='ephemeral' AND _meta.status=='DRAFT-SKELETON', parent_receipt MUST be null. Enforced by Bootstrap Protocol §4.
